# Mydeen Pitchai

> Senior Full Stack Laravel & PHP developer based in Tirunelveli, India, with 7+ years shipping web products across e-commerce, healthcare, SaaS, sports and EdTech. Senior Software Developer at OBII Kriationz Web LLP and open for freelance projects.

Mydeen scopes projects with clients, manages the timeline, writes the code and supports it after launch. Main stack: Laravel, PHP, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS S3 and AWS Lambda. Also WordPress (including headless), multilingual and Arabic RTL apps, admin panels, payment gateways and third-party APIs.

## Selected work

- [Students Xerox](https://studentsxerox.com): e-commerce printing platform. Upload, print settings, payments and live order tracking. 0 to 700+ active users in Q1, 15% faster order processing. Laravel, PostgreSQL, AWS S3, AWS Lambda, Alpine.js, Tailwind.
- [Sevens Ground](https://sevensground.ae): bilingual English and Arabic (RTL) sports booking app for a Dubai football club, with live court availability, payments and an admin panel. Laravel, Alpine.js.
- InterviewNode: career platform for engineers moving into ML. Custom WordPress plugin serving content over a REST API to a separate front end (headless).
- Motherhood: paediatric hospital platform. Admin panel UI, third-party appointment API, doctor and speciality management, hospital locator. The hospital was named ET Edge Best Mother & Child Brand 2025.
- [Blazers.io](https://blazers.io) suite: six SaaS tools listed on Capterra and G2. 20% growth in active users across 150+ customers.
- SiteBlazer (one-click hosted website builder), WPBlazer (UI redesign, RAMP Award), Proudify (certificate builder on AWS Lambda), Digital Dopamine and other SEO-optimised WordPress sites.
